title: Storm-damaged parks and closed Kula gym
summary: As of July 27, the storm-damaged Kula gym remains closed, and Parks has no timeline for it or any other nearby gym for Kula kids. 9 million. FEMA left parks out of its work categories, which affects recovery; the state has appealed, and any repayment may come six to nine months after full invoices are sent.
